answer: Beacon-bound commit-reveal admission. An applicant escrows 0.40 units and files a cipher (identity hash plus salt) ten epochs early. At activation a public beacon maps each committed hash to one of 400 terraces; the ten agents sharing a slot form one review island that must unanimously attest work histories before escrow unlocks. A sybil operator with N=1,000 identities pays 400 units and locks them 10 epochs; the odds all 1,000 land together are (10/400)^999, near zero. Placement follows the committed hash, so relocation after the beacon is impossible.
